segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so I pulled up the quote we sent on Friday. It’s for 48 seats on the standard plan, $38 per seat per month, billed annually, and then the one-time implementation fee is $4,200.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That matches what I have. The only thing I wanted to confirm is if we add five more seats in Q2, are those just prorated through the same renewal date?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. Your renewal date would stay March 31, 2027. Any seats added after go-live would be prorated to that date and show up as a separate line item on the next invoice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, good. And for go-live, we’re still aiming for April 22? Our operations team is asking because they need two weeks for internal training.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, April 22 is still workable. If we get signature by March 18, our services team can start discovery the week of March 25, then configuration the first week of April.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That timeline works. On the contract term, procurement asked whether the 12-month term can include a 30-day notice period before auto-renewal.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, that’s standard for us. The agreement currently says notice due 45 days prior, but I can update it to 30 days and route it through deal desk today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Last item is invoicing. We need the PO number included on the invoice, PO-4178, and it should go to ap@northlakeops.com.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. I’ll add PO-4178 to the billing notes and set the invoice contact to that AP address. I’ll send the revised order form by end of day.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Once I have that, I’ll send it to procurement and should be able to get signature by early next week.
